Localized marketing copy for the 5 HDrezka promo screenshots. Each slide has: eyebrow (short, ALL-CAPS-style label), title (HTML — may contain
and exactly one … highlighting the key phrase with the gradient), sub (one sentence). English is the fallback for any missing field. Rezka ships only en/ru/uk. Keep titles short; the hl span wraps the most meaningful phrase.
